lines: vite-plugin-node-polyfills, 57,317 B on the files_downloadlimit-main page: Node APIs polyfilled into a browser bundle.
12 B in 1 piece of 1 file have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (36 packages, 202 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No module is delivered twice inside one page.
No bundler chunk in build is left without something that loads it.
